title: At the End of the Radius
statement: A map, a manual heading, and half a gear establish a measured order. At their straight edge, the gear continues as an anemone: the radius is followed, but its meaning changes. A winged insect leaves the axis altogether. Interpretation begins not by discarding the instruction, but by carrying its structure somewhere it could not specify.
brief:

Represent where following an instruction ends and interpreting it begins.
